objects.description: [gh0st RAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0032) has decrypted and loaded the [gh0st RAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0032) DLL into memory, once the initial dropper executable is launched.(Citation: Gh0stRAT ATT March 2019)
